entries.purpose: Calculate saturation vapor pressure over water from temperature for the P1A controlled-environment domain.
entries.source_title: Crop evapotranspiration: Guidelines for computing crop water requirements - FAO Irrigation and drainage paper 56
entries.publication_or_organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
entries.valid_domain: 0 <= air or leaf temperature <= 50 degC; P1A rejects values outside this registered domain
assumptions: Saturation vapor pressure is represented by the FAO-56 operational equation over water.
No ice-phase equation is selected in P1A.
entries.approximation_status: scientific engineering approximation sourced from FAO-56; not a cannabis response model
notes: The selected domain is appropriate for the controlled-environment bootstrap, not an unrestricted atmospheric model.

entries.purpose: Derive ambient actual vapor pressure from saturation vapor pressure and measured relative humidity.
entries.source_title: Crop evapotranspiration: Guidelines for computing crop water requirements - FAO Irrigation and drainage paper 56
entries.publication_or_organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
entries.valid_domain: Finite non-negative saturation vapor pressure and RH in [0, 100] percent
assumptions: Relative humidity is treated as the ratio of actual to saturation vapor pressure at the measurement temperature.
entries.approximation_status: physical identity for the supplied measurement definition
notes: Invalid RH is rejected rather than silently clamped.

entries.purpose: Calculate atmospheric vapor pressure deficit from air-temperature saturation and ambient actual vapor pressure.
entries.source_title: Crop evapotranspiration: Guidelines for computing crop water requirements - FAO Irrigation and drainage paper 56
entries.publication_or_organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
entries.valid_domain: 0 <= actual vapor pressure <= saturation vapor pressure
assumptions: Both vapor pressures refer to the same air measurement state.
entries.approximation_status: physical definition; no plant response attached
notes: No good/bad range or biological multiplier is implemented.

entries.purpose: Calculate leaf VPD when an explicit leaf temperature is available.
entries.source_title: Crop evapotranspiration: Guidelines for computing crop water requirements - FAO Irrigation and drainage paper 56
entries.publication_or_organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
entries.valid_domain: Explicit leaf temperature in the registered implementation temperature domain; otherwise unavailable
assumptions: The ambient actual vapor pressure is used for the leaf boundary calculation.
Negative results are retained as condensation conditions, not clamped.
Air temperature is never substituted for unavailable leaf temperature.
entries.approximation_status: engineering extension of the sourced vapor-pressure-deficit definition; not calibrated to a cannabis canopy
notes: Leaf VPD is unavailable when leaf temperature is null.

entries.purpose: Accumulate daily light integral from time-varying PPFD over explicit simulation time.
entries.source_title: Measuring Daily Light Integral in a Greenhouse
entries.publication_or_organization: Purdue University Department of Horticulture and Landscape Architecture
entries.valid_domain: Non-negative PPFD and finite non-negative simulation duration
assumptions: PPFD is supplied at the environmental cell measurement plane.
Schedule segments are piecewise constant; integration is exact for those segments.
A day is exactly 86,400 simulation seconds.
entries.approximation_status: exact numerical accumulation for piecewise-constant input; no photosynthesis model
entries.calibration_status: not_calibrated; analytic cases and timestep partition tested
notes: The source defines PPFD and DLI as plant-relevant physical light quantities; it does not establish cannabis response constants.

entries.purpose: Track light-on duration, dark duration, and scheduled photoperiod independently from DLI.
entries.equation_or_algorithm: Accumulate each piecewise schedule interval by whether PPFD is positive; reset at explicit 86,400-second simulation-day boundaries.
entries.source_title: Calculating and Using Daily Light Integral (DLI): An Introductory Guide
entries.publication_or_organization: Virginia Tech School of Plant and Environmental Sciences
entries.valid_domain: Schedule segments within [0, 86,400] seconds with non-negative PPFD
assumptions: Light-on means positive supplied PPFD; uncovered intervals are dark.
This is environmental bookkeeping only and has no flowering response.
entries.approximation_status: engineering bookkeeping definition; no biological response
entries.calibration_status: not_calibrated; dark, variable, and day-boundary tests
notes: Photoperiod is not inferred from plant stage or cannabis conventions.
